technicalFinding: All three studies pass the tested closed-solid body/eye separation and the 50-micrometre experimental contour bound.
visualFindings: The original r0006 lid contour is restored relative to the r0007 subdivided-control edit.
At the original r0006 comparison cameras there is no convincing increase in eye realism.
The large dual area-light highlights and bright lower-iris crescent remain.
The iris, wetline, caruncle, lash and skin transitions remain too simple for a high-quality character.
decision: Retain the proven fitting procedure as technical research only. Reject a mainline promotion because visual realism has not improved. Stop varying socket clearances; prioritize eye optics and lid/wetline appearance.
futureScope: Improve optical/lid appearance without disturbing the demonstrated separation, then add and qualify blinking. No finished-character or runtime readiness claim.
scopeLimits: Five static poses only; no continuous swept collision or blink.
No full-character skin, oral, hair, clothes or motion acceptance.
The offline evaluated body has 428096 triangles; runtime LOD/import and performance remain unverified.
